cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5)
project(quadrotor_msgs)
if(NOT CMAKE_C_STANDARD)
  set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
endif()

# Default to C++14
if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 14)
endif()

if(CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNUCXX OR CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()

rosidl_generate_interfaces(${PROJECT_NAME}
"msg/PositionCommand.msg"
  # "srv/AddThreeInts.srv"
  # "action/Fibonacci.action"
  DEPENDENCIES geometry_msgs
)

if(BUILD_TESTING)
  # Archived ROS1 genpy output is not a hand-maintained ROS2 input. The active
  # PositionCommand is generated by rosidl_generate_interfaces above.
  file(GLOB_RECURSE legacy_ros1_python CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/quadrotor_msgs/*.py")
  find_package(ament_cmake_flake8 REQUIRED)
  find_package(ament_cmake_pep257 REQUIRED)
  ament_flake8(--exclude ${legacy_ros1_python})
  ament_pep257(--exclude ${legacy_ros1_python})
  list(APPEND AMENT_LINT_AUTO_EXCLUDE ament_cmake_flake8 ament_cmake_pep257)
  list(APPEND AMENT_LINT_AUTO_FILE_EXCLUDE ${legacy_ros1_python})
  set(ament_cmake_uncrustify_ADDITIONAL_ARGS LANGUAGE C++)
  find_package(ament_lint_auto REQUIRED)
  # Preserve native analysis; teach cppcheck the C++ and test-framework syntax.
  find_package(ament_cmake_cppcheck REQUIRED)
  ament_cppcheck(LANGUAGE c++ LIBRARIES googletest qt)
  list(APPEND AMENT_LINT_AUTO_EXCLUDE ament_cmake_cppcheck)
  include(cmake/legacy_notice_scope.cmake)
  ament_lint_auto_find_test_dependencies()
endif()

install(FILES ../NOTICE.md ../legacy-notice-scope.json
  DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME}/source_notices)
install(DIRECTORY ../licenses DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME}/source_notices)

ament_package()
